test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the following sentence in reported (or indirect) speech.**

They said, “We will come home this evening.”

options.text: They said that they will come home that evening.
They said that they would come home that evening.
They said that they would be coming home this evening.
They said that they would come be coming home that evening.

solution:
The correct answer is: **They said that they would come home that evening.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **direct speech**, the exact words spoken by the speaker are quoted within quotation marks and attributed directly to the speak
